findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed without compatibility or test updates
findings.body: The PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn`, and the `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`/`SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` constants from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and renames `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence` in a new module. Any other module, test, or `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` target that still uses the old paths or names will now raise ImportError or silently stop patching. The diff does not show any updates to call sites or tests, so the PR needs a repo-wide search for the old names and updated patch targets.

findings.title: Docstring typo carried into the moved helper
findings.body: The moved `get_failure_reason` docstring in `incident_occurrence.py` (line 132 of that file) reads "Builds a humam readible string". This is a typo in a function that is now being newly exposed from a new module, so it should be fixed while it is being moved.
